title: High Expressive Ratio / Motion study

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Vary a small set of recognizable ingredients so movement adds range without making the identity disappear.
strategic_value: The repeated angular wordmark and purple-linked gradients can support many Twitch expressions with a common visual origin.
demonstration: A 65-second study scales, extrudes, moves and repeats the wordmark against changing gradients, returning to simpler white signatures.
practical_value: Compare restrained signature states with extended depth and repeated wordmarks before deciding how much motion a composition needs.

content_islands.name: Signature sequence
content_islands.spec: Keep the angular white wordmark as the recurring subject while its size, position and colored depth change.

content_islands.name: Color field
content_islands.spec: Let full-frame gradients change behind the signature; later sequences repeat wordmarks across the field.

reference_purposes.Intent: The High Expressive Ratio caption describes achieving expressive range from few elements.
reference_purposes.Expression: The clip varies scale, extruded depth, color and repetition while retaining the same wordmark.

ingredient.name: Extruded wordmark
ingredient.role: Turn a familiar signature into an expressive moving graphic.
ingredient.application: Compare flat, extended and repeated signature states shown throughout the film.
ingredient.scope: Observed in the historical COLLINS identity case study; no mandatory dimensions, color proportions or universal placement rule is supplied.
